name: gilded_orbs
source: gilded_orbs, authored as 10 control points (near-black umber through bronze and old gold to a warm pale gold) as the albedo of the gilded_orbs style: the reference's warm pixels read by lightness decile, each pushed more saturated and the top end held below white, since the style's lights and glows supply the near-whites. The orbs' blue is the style's own paint, not the map's.
